title: Feature: Implement Ralph Board kanban/list task management interface
summary: A kanban/list board interface ('Ralph Board' tab) for managing AI-assisted development tasks through a multi-stage workflow with human-in-the-loop control. Tasks flow through Draft, Triage, Planning/Research loops, Ready, Executing, and Complete states, with async question handling, sub-story generation for complex features, and full git flow integration.
outOfScope: Integration with external issue trackers (GitHub Issues, Linear, etc.)
Auto-routing or auto-decisions - human decides at every gate
technicalConsiderations: New dashboard tab component alongside existing tabs
New data model for Ralph tasks with parent/child hierarchy
New background job type for planning loops (distinct from edit/ask jobs)
State machine with transition validation and audit trail
WebSocket or polling for async question updates
Integration with existing GitHub/GitLab PR creation
